en.shortDescription: Self-hosted help desk and shared inbox platform
en.longDescription:
FreeScout is an open-source help desk and shared mailbox solution for support teams.

It includes MariaDB for persistent storage and is compatible with email workflows and team collaboration.

de.longDescription:
FreeScout ist eine Open-Source-Helpdesk- und Shared-Mailbox-Lösung für Support-Teams.

Enthält MariaDB für persistenten Speicher und ist kompatibel mit E-Mail-Workflows und Team-Kollaboration.

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme helpdesk et boîte mail partagée auto-hébergée
fr.longDescription:
FreeScout est une solution helpdesk et boîte mail partagée open source pour les équipes de support.

Elle inclut MariaDB pour le stockage persistant et est compatible avec les workflows e-mail et la collaboration d'équipe.

pt.shortDescription: Plataforma auto-hospedada de helpdesk e caixa de entrada compartilhada
pt.longDescription:
FreeScout é uma solução open-source de helpdesk e caixa de correio compartilhada para equipes de suporte.

Inclui MariaDB para armazenamento persistente e é compatível com workflows de e-mail e colaboração em equipe.
